entries.zh: 应当卖，合该出售；亦指合股共卖
entries.en: it is fitting/proper to sell; to sell jointly (in partnership)

entries.zh: 应当使用；须加以利用（善用它们）
entries.en: it is fitting to use them; to make good use of them

entries.zh: 必须，应当；理应如此
entries.en: it behooves; it is necessary and fitting

entries.zh: 帽顶，帽子的顶部
entries.en: crown/top of a hat (cf. copete)
entries.notes: 西栏作 Copla de sombreros，据汉字「帽仔頭」及相邻诸条（copete del cabello、copere 等「顶部/绺」词族）判断应为 copete 之异写或误写

entries.zh: 发绺，头顶之缨（额前或顶上的一绺头发）
entries.en: forelock, tuft of the hair
entries.notes: 官话栏作 cīng，与汉字「纓」（官话 yīng）不合，疑对音栏误读；据 L+H+M 三栏定为头发顶绺义

entries.zh: 髻仔，（女子）梳的发髻
entries.en: a woman's hair-bun/topknot

entries.zh: 鬃，（牲畜头颈部的）鬃毛
entries.en: mane/crest of an animal; bristles
entries.notes: M 栏尾附「onobre:」疑为下一词头（hombre）串栏，不影响「鬃」义判定

entries.zh: 大量，充裕；丰足宽宏
entries.en: great abundance, plentiful supply; ample

entries.zh: 唱歌，（西班牙）塞吉迪亚歌谣的曲词
entries.en: singing of songs; couplets (coplas) of the seguidilla dance-song

entries.zh: 心，（任何事物的）中心、核心
entries.en: heart; the core/center of anything

entries.zh: （树木的）核，木心〔原字有疑，或作膈〕
entries.en: core/heart of a tree; kernel, pit
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注 [疑:膈]；据西语「树心」义与 M/R gûe 取「核」

entries.zh: 柴核，木柴的心材〔原字有疑，或作柴膈〕
entries.en: heartwood, the core of wood
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注 [疑:柴膈]，同上条取「核」

entries.zh: 心悲，心中悲哀；忧伤之心
entries.en: a sorrowful heart; sadness

entries.zh: 伤悲，悲伤；哀伤之心
entries.en: sorrow, grief; a heart stricken with sadness

entries.zh: 地核，大地的中心〔原字有疑，或作地膈〕
entries.en: the heart/core of the earth
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注 [疑:地膈]；据西语「大地之心」义取「地核」

entries.zh: 地狱（西语直译「大地之心」，指地下冥府）
entries.en: hell, the underworld (lit. 'heart of the earth')

entries.zh: 烦心，心绪烦扰；心事萦怀
entries.en: a troubled, preoccupied heart; vexation of mind

entries.zh: 春心，怀春之心；为爱慕而思虑萦怀
entries.en: amorous yearning; a heart anxiously bent on love

entries.zh: 寸心，方寸之心；内心思虑万千
entries.en: the small 'inch' heart; a mind teeming with a thousand cares

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: [Deficient in the original; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 汉字栏与官话栏皆 [空]；M 栏存音写 sîm chiàng / sîm būn（疑「心惊、心闷」）并杂西语 atontado（心神恍惚），语义仅为推测，不敢定谳
